The ability of the epitope specific mAb to neutralize pseudotyped lentiviral infection of cells was assessed. This Clade 7.2 strain was the only one tested from the H5N1 subtype that was not neutralized, which is in line with the presence of Tyrosine at position 121. When the WT pseudovirus was mutated to express Serine at this position, a ~3 fold increase in neutralization IC50 by the mAb was achieved.
